rules: Use official organizer sources for route and event facts wherever available.
A GPX link or button is not binary validation.
Do not delete, overwrite or replace old GPX files until a new official binary is downloaded, fully parsed and validated.
Keep historical editions separate from the 2027 edition.
Audit-only: do not change live event records or runtime files.
